title: Private Party Bus Rental in Las Vegas
blurb:
Legendary Transportation is an established Party Bus Transportation company based in Las Vegas, NV. We provide a luxury 20 passenger full-service party bus complete with your own personal driver. Our focus is to provide a one-of-a-kind luxury experience for all your transportation needs, Weddings, Sporting and Private Events, Conventions, Pool parties, Proms, Birthday Parties, Concerts, Airport Transportation and of course The Legendary Vegas Night Life. 

Just hop aboard our Legendary amenity-packed party bus and let the festivities begin. With wraparound seating, a stripper pole, AUX/Bluetooth connections, speakers pumping your favorite tunes, nightclub lighting, and even on-board bars if you so desire. Legendary Transportation transforms any night out into a Legendary Event! Free Hotel pick up and drop off, complementary water.
